Game Overview

In Green Goblin Attack, the core idea is straightforward: race through a vibrant world as you dodge fearsome goblins and treacherous monsters. Jump and shoot your way to survival while collecting gleaming coins. With its simple controls and endless fun, "Green Goblin Attack" offers an exciting, family-friendly adventure for all ages. Can you master the goblin onslaught?
